✓ checked calendar · 7:30 free
✓ booking created · note added

Perfect, thank you!

setup: Your opening hours and table sizes

faqs.question: What if we are fully booked?
faqs.answer: It offers the nearest free times and can add the guest to a waitlist in your sheet.

faqs.question: Can guests cancel?
faqs.answer: Yes, but by default a cancellation comes to you first for a one-tap OK. You can change that.

faqs.question: Does it work with my booking system?
faqs.answer: It works with Google Calendar and Sheets out of the box. Systems with an API can be connected, and systems without one can be used through a connected computer.

en.title: 24-hour help desk
en.description: Answers order, delivery and policy questions any time, and hands tricky ones to your team.

messages.text: Tue 3:12 AM
My order #4821 still hasn’t arrived. Where is it?
✓ looked up order #4821
Sorry for the wait! #4821 shipped yesterday and arrives tomorrow by 6 PM. Tracking: KT-55210.
Can I get a refund if it is late?
I’ve passed that to the team. They’ll reply by 10 AM.

faqs.question: Will it make things up?
faqs.answer: It answers from the documents and data you connect. When it does not know, it says so and hands off.

faqs.question: Can it handle many chats at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every conversation runs in parallel.

faqs.question: Can it issue refunds?
faqs.answer: Not by default. Refunds are “Not allowed” in this template; you can switch them to “Ask me first”.

faqs.question: Does the AI see my portal password?
faqs.answer: No. Saved logins are encrypted and filled directly into the exact website; the AI never sees them.

faqs.question: Can I watch what it’s doing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open the live desktop from your browser and take over at any moment.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use my own computer?
faqs.answer: Machine access is off by default and you switch on browser, files or shell one by one. For stronger isolation, use the NyxID container or a hosted VM.

faqs.question: AI 能看到我的后台密码吗？
faqs.answer: 不能。已保存的登录信息经过加密，只会直接填入指定网站，AI 永远看不到。
